title: Standard event constants and classes
content_data:
This document lists the standard event name constants for the TikTok App Events SDK. Use these constants to ensure consistent event tracking across both platforms. For general events, use `TikTokBusinessSdk.trackTTEvent(EventName.YOUR_EVENT_CONSTANT)` on Android and `[TikTokBusiness trackTTEvent:yourEventConstant]` on iOS. For commerce and contents events, use the `TTContentsEvent` builder classes on Android and `TikTokContentsEvent` subclasses on iOS. If you are unable to use the provided constants or builder classes, you may reference the string value in the first "Event" column instead. > **Important**
> **Deprecation Note** >
Events marked as deprecated should not be used in new integrations. They are maintained for backward compatibility but will be removed in future versions of the SDK. ## General standard events ```xtable |Event{12%}|Android Constant{13%}|iOS Objective-C String
